reason: B is the more restrained letter, and that makes it harder for me to dismiss. It points out that the 74 signatures are two-thirds of the building, notes that the first 6-to-8-week promise ran out in the month of the worst outage, and asks for three specific things in writing, while the TV station mention adds quiet pressure. A covers similar ground but runs longer, makes more demands, and claims the delay has gone on five months, which the facts don't establish.
